# MichaelOS

> A calmer, more intentional way to plan your day. MichaelOS combines personal
> daily planning — tasks, goals, habits and calendar availability — with team
> project, capacity and timeline planning for organizations.

MichaelOS is a web application. Almost all of it sits behind authentication:
the only public page is the landing page at `/`. Everything under `/work`,
`/products`, `/onboarding`, `/accept-invitation` and `/api` requires a signed-in
session and returns private, per-user or per-organization data. Those paths are
disallowed in `robots.txt` and must not be crawled, summarized or cited.

## What it does

- **LifestyleOS** — personal daily planning: tasks, goals, habits, calendar
  availability and a daily and weekly review.
- **WorkOS** — organization planning: teams, projects, work tasks, capacity and
  resource planning, adaptive scheduling and delivery timelines.
- **Michael AI** — an assistant that drafts records for the user to review and
  save. It never writes on the user's behalf without an explicit save.

- [Home](/): product overview and entry point.
